admission.justification: The task-document writer, worktree start, role workspace and stage planner enforce one answer, preventing a leaf from starting work before the developer has supplied go.

applicability: Canonical subTask creation/edit/publication, worktree start or planning attach, leaf-role workspace resolution and task stage planning. Existing inProgress/later attach does not restart work; master documents carry no intentReview.
conditions: A native subTask review is pending or review-first.
Leaf creation defaults to pending only when the caller supplied no intentReview.
A bound hosted answer writer is the Architect; an unbound developer may write the answer.
exclusions: A master document, which admits no intentReview field.
An older leaf with no field or a review at go.
Re-entering an already inProgress/later enclosure, which is not a new start.

evidence: scratch/curator/b5e6f7a8-9c01-4d23-8e45-f6a7b8c9d012/helpers/backend/post-L194-source-equivalence.json; semantic-recommendations.json; MIK-R189@v1 rules2,8; MIK-R189@v2 rule2 amendment

statement: Creation of a leaf without a supplied intentReview defaults it to pending; pending or review-first blocks every new leaf start and planning/abandoned-to-inProgress transition with intent-review-open before worktree or seat creation. An absent older-leaf field or go admits the existing start path. Only the bound architect, or a developer without a seat binding, changes the answer; replacement preserves it and no write may erase it.
